The '''Plasma Cut Boarding Device''' was an [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]]-mounted [[Plasma torch/Legends|plasma torch]] boarding device manufactured by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]]. It was installed in a standard airlock system, and consisted of a telescoping [[Armor/Legends|armored]] "[[Docking tube/Legends|boarding tube]]," capable of creating an airtight seal on a [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Hull/Legends|hull]]&mdash;or airlock&mdash;within thirty seconds. A high intensity [[Plasma torch/Legends|plasma torch]] assembly integrated into the seal's frame acted as a [[hull-cutting ring]], and was capable of cutting a one-[[Meter/Legends|meter]]-by-two-meter hole within a minute of sealing.
